items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: whenever I had a chance to have a lesson like with Ray or with Jimmy Woode in the beginning

ctx.x: Yes, very profound, yeah. Around this period you also went to publishing a bass learning methods also, so I’d like to know what brought you to publish a method for the bass players?

It started very early and for some reason I was maybe at that time, whenever I had a chance to have a lesson like with Ray or with Jimmy Woode in the beginning, of course I took a piece of paper and, trying to memorize what the person has given to you. So okay, so basically we spoke about that, we spoke about that. Okay. You take notes. And then it became an habit. Whenever I would get a lesson from somebody, or I would give a lesson, when I started to have a few students, or I would be witnessing, like if you…
